findings.text: the test_logs field in the reviewed run's manifest points at <run_dir>/test_logs_after.tsv and (at :16) <run_dir>/test_logs_baseline.log, neither of which exists in the run directory; the actual 76/73/64-pass results survive only as /tmp/sev_*.log files the manifest does not name, so a reader following the recorded receipts finds nothing.

justifications.durability: running the new raised-severity case against the parent 467016b budget.py in a hermetic copy fails with assert False is True at tests/test_severity_floor.py:280 (the exact defect), while the unraised-with-no-figure companion passes at the same pre-fix code, so both the new hold and the retained clear are pinned against regression.
justifications.evidence: independently re-ran the full gate at the reviewed head b316011 and got 76 passed, 0 failed (tests/test_severity_floor.py + tests/test_budget.py, log /tmp/rev_sf_floor_gate.log), matching the worker's stated 76; docked two because the manifest's baseline_suite/after_suite are prose rather than the armed revision/exit/log JSON shape and its test_logs entries (manifest.md:15-16) reference paths that do not exist in the run directory while the real logs survive only in /tmp unnamed.
justifications.fit: the floor rides the established RAISED_SEVERITIES vocabulary and D02 format_refusal mechanism at reckon/budget.py:1243 and reuses the _position and _evidence_note helpers, adds no new public name, and names the local input by what it describes with no naming-rule hits beyond the pre-existing D02 output code.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/budget.py:1243 now consults the severity floor before the None-utilisation guard, so decide() on a reading with known headroom, severity='critical' and utilisation_pct=None returns held=True instead of the early clear, and each of the done-when's three facts is pinned by the new cases at tests/test_severity_floor.py:263 and :291.
justifications.scope_discipline: commit b316011 touches exactly the two declared write paths (git show --name-only lists only reckon/budget.py and tests/test_severity_floor.py), the reviewed worktree is clean at its head, ruff adds no finding (4=4 on budget.py, test file clean), and the message has a body with no plan identifiers and no AI attribution.
